name: arch
description: Current technical planning for devflow-managed projects. Takes product.md and current Layer 0, decides or refreshes components, stack, code structure, the verify channel, Brownfield-preserving architecture, and capability design zones. Use when explicitly invoked, when Resume routes a managed marker or baseline refresh, or for work in an existing devflow-managed project; Adopt remains the initial unmanaged reconstruction entry.
problem: Preserve the behavior of the immutable repository source at skills/arch without silently changing its obligations.
state_dependent_behaviors: Initial architecture approval writes Brownfield: no, while managed refresh preserves the current observed Brownfield value.
A partial setup.no-product state with implementation code or brownfield history routes to Resume; Arch never redirects managed recovery to Adopt.

Arch consumes both valid legacy writer=adopt and current writer=arch knowledge markers; writer is provenance, mixed sets stay in Arch until drained, and only invalid or unsupported markers fail integrity.
judgment_points: Every source atom remains review-required until explicitly disposed.
